subject: Next steps and 30-minute product walkthrough — availability
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fluxhealth.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@fluxhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps and 30-minute product walkthrough — availability

Hi Nora / Ethan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed next step so we keep momentum: 

- Key goals you shared: reduce inference cost for batch reports, improve tail latency on user-facing features, and a safe rollout path for PHI-bearing prompts.
- Current infra: hybrid cloud, PostgreSQL-backed metadata store, existing auth via Okta (SAML).
- Success criteria for POC: <20% token cost reduction vs current baseline, p95 latency under 300ms for priority endpoints, clear routing policy to isolate PHI traffic.

Next step: propose a 30-minute product walkthrough (high level + brief technical alignment) with the stakeholders you mentioned. Two options that work on our side:

  1) Wednesday, Mar 24 — 10:00–10:30 PT (1:00–1:30 ET)
  2) Thursday, Mar 25 — 13:00–13:30 PT (4:00–4:30 ET)

If neither is workable, suggest one or two windows that fit your team and I’ll send provisional invites. Please confirm who should attend from Flux Health (recommended: product owner, tech lead, and security/infra).

I’ve attached a very short discovery notes PDF and a placeholder SOW template for context. Also: if there are any non-negotiable compliance items (SSO, data residency, audit logs), flag them now so we include the right people.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0113

Attachments: 20270322-discovery-notes-flux.pdf (summary of call), SOW-briefing-placeholder.docx (template)

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fluxhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@fluxhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps and 30-minute product walkthrough — availability

Thanks, Aditya — really appreciate the quick recap. Helpful.

Couple notes from our side:  
- Wednesday morning (Mar 24 at 10 PT) is tight for our product lead. Would it be possible to do Wednesday at 1:00 PM ET instead? That would work best.
- We will want our security lead on the call to confirm SSO and data retention expectations. Im looping Jamal (IT/security) on this thread — Jamal, can you confirm whether SAML + SCIM provisioning is enough for an initial POC or if we need an enterprise integration plan?

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an audit-log snapshot for the demo data and whether data-at-rest encryption is enabled by default? If you can share a short doc or link, thatd be great.

Nora
Director of Product, Flux Health
Nora.Patel@fluxhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0222

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fluxhealth.com>, Jamal Singh <jamal.singh@fluxhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@fluxhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps and 30-minute product walkthrough — availability

Nora / Jamal —

Thanks — Wednesday at 1:00 PM ET (Wed, Mar 24 13:00 ET) works for us. Ive provisionally booked a 30-minute slot and included a Zoom link; I will send a calendar invite once you confirm the final attendee list.

Quick answers to Jamals likely questions:
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML SSO with Okta and SCIM for provisioning; we can provide a short integration checklist prior to the demo.
- Audit logs & encryption: audit logs are available for dedicated and private deployments; hosted API provides request logs with configurable retention—I attached a one-page notes file and a placeholder SOW that includes longer retention options. Data-at-rest encryption is enabled by default for hosted deployments; for Private we integrate with customer KMS.

Prep items before the demo (15 min of reading at most):
1) Quick discovery summary (attached)
2) SSO & security checklist (link: https://redwood.app/sec/sso-checklist)
3) Short architecture diagram request: could Jamal share a high-level network diagram (VPC/egress rules) if you plan to evaluate Private deployment?

If Jamal is comfortable with SAML + SCIM for POC, well keep the demo focused on integration patterns and model routing. If you need an enterprise-only path, flag that and Ill loop in our solutions engineer for the technical deep dive.

Ill send a calendar invite for Wed 13:00 ET with the Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890. Please let me know if anyone else should be added.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0113

Attachments: SOW-briefing-placeholder.docx
